summary: Murder conviction based on unreliable testimony; child witness (6 years at time of incident) credibility issues; delayed recording of witness statements (17 days post-incident); timeline inconsistencies in prosecution narrative; gunshot wound vs stone injuries contradiction; post-mortem showing stab wound misaligned with eyewitness accounts; appeal allowed due to insufficient evidence and embellished testimonies.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; convictions and sentences set aside; all four appellants acquitted.
